name: The Black Rider (Khamûl)
voice: A dry, hissing whisper without warmth; short questions repeated. Never lengthy. Dialogue with riders is scripted in-game, not LLM-driven.
speech_samples: Where is it? Where is Baggins?

knowledge.fact: Seeks a Baggins of the Shire who bears the Ring, and sniffs it out by scent.
